description: Get detailed room information, prices, and images for a specific hotel. Provides comprehensive hotel details including room types, pricing, facilities, images, and policies. Use after hotel_search when the user asks about one hotel's rooms, prices or photos. Takes the hotel's id from hotel_search as hotel_id, with the same dates (DD.MM.YYYY). Each offer's free_cancellation_until and cancellation_rules give the cancellation deadline and fees. The user books through that hotel's detail_link.

children.description: Ages of children as list (e.g., [8, 12] for 8 and 12 year olds)

limit.description: Number of results per page (max 30, default: 30)

name: hotel_room_detail
title: Hotel rooms and prices
